_comment: EGM Downloader Mac update feed. Upload to egerena.com/apps/egmac-update.json
_version_notes: Update Plugins panel moved into hamburger → Advanced tab — cleaner main page
Collapsible plugins grid with Show/Hide toggle — state remembered across app restarts
Section dividers in Advanced tab — Channels, Plugins, Maintenance grouping
Clear cache moved to maintenance zone (after Plugins, before Reset settings)
Auto-collapse plugins panel after check when all plugins are current
Update modal now scrollable — max-height 90vh, body scrolls, buttons stay fixed

notes: New: Update Plugins panel moved into hamburger → Advanced tab — cleaner main page
New: Collapsible plugins grid with Show/Hide toggle — state remembered across app restarts
New: Section dividers in Advanced tab — Channels, Plugins, Maintenance grouping
Polish: Clear cache moved to maintenance zone (after Plugins, before Reset settings)
Polish: Auto-collapse plugins panel after check when all plugins are current
Fix: Update modal now scrollable — max-height 90vh, body scrolls, buttons stay fixed

New: 140 new themes — mythology (20), Conejo Malo series 2.0–5.0 (4), sports (10), decades (10), memes (6), cities of the world (30), Balance Pack (11), Futuristic (9), Planets & Space (10), Brands (20), Venues (10), 8-Bit Era (10) — total now 400 themes
New: Theme Favorites — heart toggle on every theme card, dedicated Favorites sidebar section, persists across restart and in settings export/import, server-side validation (XSS-safe, deduped, capped)
New: Random theme on launch — optional toggle with Favorites only or All themes scope
New: yt-dlp update channel toggle (Stable / Nightly) in Advanced panel — nightly brings frequent improvements, switch back to Stable force-reinstalls
New: ffmpeg update channel toggle (Stable / Nightly) in Advanced panel — Mac uses martin-riedl.de snapshot/release, Linux uses BtbN master/n8.1, Windows uses BtbN master/n8.1
Fix: YouTube signature solving — adds --remote-components ejs:github to all yt-dlp commands
Fix: ffmpeg downloads in background — app loads immediately even on slow connections, no frozen splash
Fix: ffmpeg readiness gate — downloads return clear message while ffmpeg is still downloading instead of failing silently
Fix: atomic file writes now use fsync — prevents empty files on power loss
Fix: thumbnail download hardened — SSRF guard blocks internal hosts, Content-Length pre-check rejects oversized images, redirect re-check
Fix: whats-new feed now verified against signed manifest before displaying
Fix: history API validates pagination params — prevents 500 errors on bad input, caps per_page at 500
Fix: flask_port precedence — Electron's PORT env always wins over stale settings, prevents stuck-on-loading
Fix: DST-aware timestamps in update feeds — no longer hardcodes -05:00
Fix: yt-dlp nightly install uses download-first approach — bundled pip can't handle GitHub URLs directly
Fix: save/rename modal no longer dismisses on overlay click — only Cancel, Save, or Escape close it
Refactor: index.html split into index + index_scripts + index_styles — source maintainability, rendered output byte-identical
Refactor: THEME_DATA unified into single shared partial (theme_data.html) — eliminates duplication between main window and themes window, one entry point for all theme changes
New: double-click theme card to favorite/unfavorite — complements heart icon click
New: arrow key navigation in themes window — left/right between cards, up/down between rows, Enter applies theme, F toggles favorite
Polish: Escape clears theme search — hands stay on keyboard
Polish: accent pulse feedback on theme apply via Enter key
Cleanup: removed unused InvalidSignature import from all app.py — dead code
Cleanup: removed unreferenced icon-1024.png (515KB saved)
Polish: sidebar section headers and theme counts improved readability across all themes
Refactor: sidebar reorganized — Style, Vibe, Pop Culture, Heritage, Other; Seasonal promoted to top-level; Planets merged into Space; empty COLORS category removed
Refactor: _TOKEN_EXEMPT consolidated — thumbnail prefix moved from inline check to _TOKEN_EXEMPT_PREFIX tuple
Polish: settings import notes thumbnails are not included after reinstall
Polish: ffmpeg reinstall button removed — redundant with channel toggles
Polish: Flask port setting removed from Advanced panel — port is hardcoded in Electron, setting could never take effect
Security: IPC sender validation (isTrustedSender) on all Electron handlers — all platforms
Security: Electron settings writes now atomic (atomicWriteJson) — all platforms
Security: file imports capped at 2MB (readFileCapped) — all platforms
Security: integer input validation (_clamp_int) — prevents 500 on malformed params
Security: preload bridge validates inputs before sending IPC (isStr, THEME_RE, isHttpUrl) — all platforms
Security: external links restricted to HTTPS only, navigation pinned to Flask origin — all platforms
Security: Deno download verified against published SHA-256 checksum — all platforms

Test: 32 automated tests — security parity (app.py + main.js + preload.js × 3 platforms), theme count consistency, HTML div balance, linux template parity, ejs download path, favorites sanitization, port resolution, channel URL validation, template Jinja render integrity
Fix: 13 theme similarity fixes — accent color adjustments to differentiate visually similar themes across categories
Fix: 5 existing space themes migrated to new Planets category — cleaner taxonomy
Fix: Advanced panel layout — removed CSS transform that triggered Chromium compositor paint bug on Mac/Linux
Chore: Electron 42.2.0 → 42.3.2 (Chromium 148, security patches, faster launch)

New: 22 Operating System themes — Windows (95, 98, XP, Vista, 7, 11), macOS (9, X Aqua, Big Sur, Sequoia), Linux (Ubuntu, Arch, Kali, Fedora), and retro OS (BeOS, Amiga, DOS, NeXTSTEP, OS/2 Warp, Solaris, Unix, BSD) — total now 260 themes
Fix: theme registry corrections — void, aurora-deep, St. Patrick's Day, and Valentine's Day now correctly registered with proper labels and categories
Polish: sidebar category labels and search placeholders now readable across all themes — contrast audit resolved 4 additional surfaces using the same fix pattern as v0.99.11
Robustness: settings, history, and cookies now written atomically — no file corruption on crash or power loss mid-write
Fix: strict image format detection on cached thumbnails — unknown formats rejected instead of mis-tagged as JPG; WAV-tagged-as-WebP stops happening
Fix: Content-Type header validated before reading thumbnail body — non-image responses close immediately without consuming bandwidth
Fix: placeholder text and section labels now use theme-aware color across all 238 themes — closes v0.99.11 known issue
Security: signed update manifests — ed25519 signature verified on every update check before any content is trusted; unsigned or tampered manifests silently rejected

Security: structured security event logging — all security-relevant events (token mismatch, host rejection, checksum failure, path traversal, thumbnail URL rejection, manifest verification failure) logged to console and rotating DATA_DIR/logs/security.log
Quality: unit test suite — 17 tests covering cross-platform parity, security boundaries, and historical regressions; wired into GitHub Actions CI (runs on every push to main)

New: 67 themes added — Puerto Rico Collection (22 themes celebrating Ponce, the island, holidays, icons, and culture), Team Easter Eggs (5 themes named after the team behind EGM), and category expansion (cities, space, movies, retro, music, moods, architecture, food, weather)
New: Puerto Rico themes with flag identifier — featured first under Heritage
Polish: 36 themes received contrast readability improvements (text2 and log-text bumps; Savathûn identity rework; Valhalla palette differentiation from N64)
Fix: themes window sidebar no longer scrolls away with the page — sidebar and grid scroll independently at any theme count
Security: thumbnail fetching restricted to HTTPS-only; rejects file://, ftp://, http:// schemes (defense-in-depth, documented in SECURITY.md)
Docs: SECURITY.md updated with documented threat-model decision for thumbnail CDN fetching
Known Issues: Some placeholder text and section labels may have low contrast on certain themes. A fix is ready and will ship in the next release.

New: video thumbnails on download history — locally cached, shown in hamburger list (cropped) and expanded history (blurred fill for vertical videos); fallback icons for audio and pre-thumbnail entries
New: per-video thumbnail cleanup on history delete, bulk cleanup on cache clear
Fix: single-download audio quality selector now offers full format options (MP3 128/192/320, FLAC, M4A 256, OPUS 128/192) matching the Download All modal — respects saved default

Note: audio quality is the target output — actual quality is bounded by source. Selecting MP3 320 kbps from a source that only offers 128 kbps gives you an MP3 file at the source's actual quality. Format conversion (MP3/FLAC/OPUS) always works as selected.
New: splash redesign — replaced progress bar with spinning indicator and pulsing dots; visually consistent across all startup scenarios including ffmpeg/Deno reinstall
Polish: settings folder hint label removed from header
New: 30 themes added — Eras & Decades (10), Mythology (10), International Seasonal (10); 29 contrast readability fixes; alphabetical sort in themes window
